verdict.description: Your proposed verdict. The service recomputes it from the issues: any blocker or major finding means it is never posted as APPROVE.

summary.description: The top of the review body in GitHub markdown: what the change does and what you checked. Do not repeat the issues here.

issues.description: Every finding of this review, nits included. Empty if none.

path.description: File path relative to the repository root, as shown in the diff. Empty string for a PR-wide finding.

line.description: Anchor line: new-file numbering for RIGHT, old-file for LEFT. null when the finding is not tied to a changed line.

start_line.description: First line of a multi-line range, or null.

body.description: The full comment in GitHub markdown, with how it was verified.

prior_issues.description: Re-reviews only: the status of each finding from the previous review. Empty for an initial review.

comment_id.description: The previous finding's comment_id as given, or null.

note.description: How it was (or was not) addressed.
